question: Choose the antonym of 'withdraw':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Advance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Withdraw"** means to remove oneself or something from a particular situation or place, or to pull back. (वापस लेना)

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to withdraw her application for the job after careful consideration.
 
 
 
• **"Advance"** refers to moving forward, progressing, or improving. It is the antonym of withdraw, as it implies moving ahead rather than pulling back. (आगे बढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** The army began to advance toward the enemy's position.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'withdraw' **is **'advance'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Advance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Remove** (हटाना): To take something away or eliminate it.

 
 
• **Example:** Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
 
 
 
• **Recede** (पीछे हटना): To go or move back from a previous position.
 
 
• **Example:** The floodwaters began to recede after the rain stopped.
 
 
 
• **Deduct** (कटौती करना): To subtract or take away an amount from a total.
 
 
• **Example:** The bank will deduct the charges from your account.
